components.note: 又 (right hand) — a hand with a dot between the fingers, the idea of a fork or crossing; also in 友 friend, 取 take.
扌 (hand) — pulling or prying by hand; also in 拉 pull, 推 push.
反 (fǎn) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 板 bǎn, 版 bǎn and 饭 fàn.
木 (wood) — trees; 梅 is the plum tree, as in 树 tree, 林 forest.
每 (měi) gives the same syllable with a different tone; it also sounds out 悔 huǐ and 海 hǎi.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body parts, as in 脸 face, 肚 belly; 腔 is a body cavity.
空 (kōng, hollow) is a loose sound clue and fits the meaning: a hollow space.
口 (mouth) — throat and voice; also in 叫 shout, 唱 sing.
桑 (sāng) gives a close sound for sǎng.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings, as in 怕 afraid, 惭 ashamed; 愧 is guilt in the heart.
鬼 (guǐ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 魁 kuí.
艹 (grass) — plants; 蔬 are vegetables, as in 菜 vegetable, 草 grass.
疏 (shū) gives the exact sound.
艹 (grass) — plants; 菜 is vegetables, as in 草 grass, 花 flower.
采 (cǎi) is the same syllable with a different tone; it also sounds out 彩 cǎi and 踩 cǎi.
口 (mouth) — scaring with a shout; also in 叫 shout, 吓 frighten.
虎 (hǔ) gives the exact sound — a tiger's roar. In 吓唬 it reads xià hu.
禾 (grain) — 秒 first meant a grain's fine tip; also in 种 plant, 秋 autumn.
少 (shǎo) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 妙 miào and 纱 shā.
土 (earth) — banking up soil around plants; also in 地 ground, 城 city.
咅 (pōu) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 陪 péi and 赔 péi.
禾 (grain) — neatly stacked crops, hence order; also in 种 plant, 秋 autumn.
失 (shī) is only a loose sound clue for zhì.
犭 (animal, 反犬旁) — beasts and hunting dogs, as in 狗 dog, 猫 cat, 狼 wolf.
口 (mouth) — a cry of sorrow; also in 叫 shout, 哭 weep.
衣 (yī) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 依 yī.
野 (wilds, countryside) — a house in the countryside, hence a villa.
土 (earth) — land and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city.
艹 (grass) — plants; 艾 is mugwort, a medicinal herb, as in 草 grass, 药 medicine.
乂 (yì) is only a loose sound clue for ài.
口 (mouth) — presenting in words; also in 叫 shout, 问 ask. 呈 also sounds out 程 chéng and 逞 chěng.
⺮ (bamboo, 竹字头) — cages and baskets are woven of bamboo; also in 筷 chopsticks, 篮 basket.
龙 (lóng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 聋 lóng and 咙 lóng.
忄 (heart) — hatred in the heart; also in 恨 hate, 怕 afraid.
曾 (zēng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 增 zēng and 赠 zèng.
犭 (animal, 反犬旁) — a watching beast; also in 猫 cat, 狗 dog.
且 (qiě) is only a loose sound clue for jū.
虫 (insect, creature) — small animals, as in 蛇 snake, 蚊 mosquito.
圭 (guī) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 娃 wá and 洼 wā.
扌 (hand) — hitting or throwing oneself; also in 打 hit, 推 push.
卜 (bǔ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 朴 pǔ and 仆 pú.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body parts, as in 脸 face, 腿 leg.
殿 (diàn) is only a loose sound clue for tún.
贝 (shell, old money) — greed for wealth; also in 财 wealth, 买 buy.
今 (jīn) is a loose sound clue; it also sounds out 含 hán and 琴 qín.
女 (woman) — the woman radical, as in 妈 mom, 好 good; its link to 婪 (greedy) is only historical.
林 (lín) gives a close sound for lán.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — thread that draws in; also in 红 red, 级 level.
宿 (sù) gives a close sound; it also appears in 宿舍 dormitory.
虍 (tiger head) — the top of 虎; it also appears in 虑 lǜ and 虐 nüè, but in 虚 the link to tigers is lost.
广 (building, shelter) — houses and rooms, as in 店 shop, 床 bed, 座 seat. 庄 is pronounced like 壮 zhuàng and 装 zhuāng, from the traditional 莊.
氵 (water) — sweat is water of the body; also in 河 river, 汤 soup.
干 (gān) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 旱 hàn and 焊 hàn.
日 (sun) — brightness and clarity; also in 明 bright, 晴 sunny.
析 (xī) gives the exact sound.
宀 (roof) — a person resting on a mat under a roof: to lodge, as in 家 home, 安 peace. Also read xiǔ and xiù.
人 — the top is a roof shape over a dwelling, as in 宿舍; the lower part is not the tongue of 舌.
酉 (wine jar) — drink, as in 酒 liquor, 醒 sober.
卒 (zú) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 翠 cuì and 碎 suì.
艹 (grass) — plants and fungi; also in 草 grass, 菜 vegetable.
囷 (qūn) gives a close sound for jūn.
木 (wood) — trees; also in 树 tree, 林 forest.
闾 (lǘ) gives the sound; it contains 吕 lǚ, which also sounds out 侣 lǚ and 铝 lǚ.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — fine threads and cloth; also in 红 red, 级 level.
少 (shǎo) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 沙 shā (sand) and 砂 shā.
阝 (mound, 左耳旁 on the left) — land and hills, as in 院, 阳, 队. The right part is a simplification with no sound clue.
足 (foot, ⻊) — foot actions, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump.
交 (jiāo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 胶 jiāo and 郊 jiāo.
门 (gate) — looking things over at the gate; also in 问 ask, 间 between.
兑 (duì) is a loose clue; 悦 yuè shares it and sounds exactly like 阅.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — passing things along, as in 道 road, 送 send, 过 pass.
弟 (dì) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 第 dì and 梯 tī.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — fine threads, hence delicate; also in 红 red, 级 level.
千 (qiān) gives only a rough sound for xiān.
穴 (cave, hole) — creeping in through a hole; also in 空 empty, 窗 window.
切 (qiè) gives the exact sound.
尸 (body, a crouching figure) — also in 屁 and 屎; 尿 is body plus 水 (water).
水 (water) — liquid passed from the body.
木 (wood) — a wooden cabinet; also in 桌 table, 椅 chair.
巨 (jù) is only a stand-in; the traditional 櫃 used 贵 guì for the sound.
扌 (hand) — pounding and poking by hand; also in 打 hit, 拍 pat.
岛 (dǎo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 导 dǎo.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — twisted threads, a tangle; also in 红 red, 级 level.
丩 (jiū, two strands twisted) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 叫 jiào and 收 shōu.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — wrapping with thread; also in 红 red, 级 level.
雨 (rain) — weather radical, as in 雪 snow, 雾 fog; 雷 also sounds out 镭 léi and 蕾 lěi.
氵 (water) — immersed in water; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
奄 (yǎn) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 掩 yǎn and 腌 yān.
田 (field) — animals raised on farmland; also in 男 male, 界 border. Read chù for livestock, xù for to raise.
